Gutierrez says the US has gone too far with tariffs and that easing them could help reduce inflationary pressure on American consumers. Gutierrez says the US has the infrastructure and capabilities to be a strong exporter, but should focus on high-value industries rather than making consumers pay more to bring back lower-value production.
